concerns.text: FR-007 requires a disclaimer that all findings are associational only, but no task in tasks.md ensures this disclaimer is added to the final report (e.g., a task to insert the disclaimer into docs/report.md).
FR-008 mandates that the entire pipeline runs within 6 hours and uses ≤ 7 GB RAM, yet there is no task that measures or asserts runtime or peak memory usage.
FR-016 calls for generating a JSON schema for the TailIndexEstimate entity and saving it to the contracts directory, but tasks.md contains no task that creates or validates this schema file.
SC-001 requires both a retention‑rate ≥ 95 % and that the pipeline does not exceed memory limits; while retention is checked (T003), there is no task that verifies the memory‑usage constraint.
SC-002 demands that at least three distinct parametric models converge with finite AIC/BIC scores, yet no task explicitly checks or asserts this convergence count.
SC-004 expects the best‑fitting model to be selected via the lowest AIC before applying tail‑diagnostic R² ≥ 0.95, but no task validates that the lowest‑AIC model is chosen prior to rejection logic.
SC-005 sets a hard deadline of 3600 seconds for the full analysis, but tasks.md lacks any task that records or enforces total runtime.
SC-003 requires the Hill estimator to produce a finite tail‑index value; while T010 runs the estimator, there is no verification step confirming the finiteness of the output.
SC-009 calls for reporting the variance‑minimization results of the Hill stability analysis, yet no task explicitly verifies that these results are recorded in the output JSON.
